structured.feedback: It overpromises on breathability ("allows air to pass through with ease") and comfort ("without discomfort") despite mixed reviews saying the masks are hard to breathe through, and it leans on repetitive, generic wording ("comfortable" appears about four times, "wash after wash," "again and again").
